page0.text:
"...ya! Emiya!"
"Agh..."
At the voice, I open my eyes.
...My body feels hot.
The nausea won't go away, my head feels woozy, and I can't even stand up on my own.
"Are you awake? It's okay now! Do you recognize me!?"
I feel someone slapping my cheeks.

page1.text:
"...Yeah. Only you would slap me at a time like this, Tohsaka."
"...Thank god. If you can snark, then you must be fine."
...I wasn't trying to be flippant. It's just how I feel.

page2.text: "What are you laughing at, stupid? ...Just so you know, I'm not thanking you. Never pull something like that again. If you die, I won't be able to repay my debt."

page3.text:
She shoots me a glare.
Even so, Tohsaka has one hand supporting my back, while the other is holding my hand as if to check my temperature.

page4.text:
"...Tohsaka? Um, did something weird happen?"
"You disappeared. You stepped on the shadow, and I thought you fell, but you were just gone. I think it came from over there."

page5.text: Tohsaka looks to the southern sky—no, the southwest, and grinds her teeth.

page6.text:
"...Oh. But I felt like I was wrapped up in there forever."
"...Really? It's been less than ten seconds since you jumped into that thing. I'll prove it, look—"

page7.text:
"Shirou!"
Saber comes running.
"Why did you attempt such folly again!?"
Saber supports me on her shoulder, and takes me from Tohsaka.

page8.text:
"Stand away, Master of Archer. If you approach my Master again, I will consider it hostile action."
"Wait, what? Are we enemies?"

page9.text:
"Of course. You are a Master, and you brought Archer with you.
I don't know what Shirou's motive was for protecting you, but I cannot allow anyone to so easily approch my Master."

page10.text:
Saber glares at Tohsaka.
...Oh, no. Come to think of it, I never updated Saber on the situation.

page11.text:
"It's not like that, Saber. Tohsaka and I have a truce right now. Until we defeat Caster, that is."
"Shirou!? Stop, you must rest!"
"I said she isn't our enemy. We have a deal."

page12.text:
"...I understand. If you say so, then I won't fight her. So please..."
"...Yeah, sorry. To be honest, I can't...talk..."

page13.text:
I desperately cling to consciousness as my mind strains under chills and nausea.
I can pass out once I get home.
Until then, I need to keep my mind together, at least.

page14.text:
"He survived? Well, he didn't touch the main body. Someone with a physical body might get off with only a fever."
Archer comes over.
His expression is neutral, even though he let Zouken escape. He's the calmest one here.

page15.text:
"...Archer. Do you know something about that shadow?"
"...Not really. But one thing is for certain: that is what's been taking magical energy from people around the city ever since Caster died."

page16.text:
Archer sounds indifferent.
Then, he directs his attention to me on the ground.

page17.text:
"It appears this is no longer the time to settle personal grievances. Isn't that right, Shirou Emiya?"
"...Huh?"
"Your instincts are correct about what that thing is.
...Hmph. To think I'd be summoned as a Servant, but end up fighting that."

page18.text:
"Archer...? What are you..."
Ah, right. You aren't a Guardian yet. You won't have faced its kind before... Good grief. The job never changes, no matter where I go.

page19.text:
The red knight leaves, beckoning Tohsaka to go with him.
But before he does...

page20.text:
"...Your prospects aren't so grim quite yet.
Nothing has happened yet. Will you survive and clean up the aftermath, or nip this in the bud? There are still avenues open to you."
He murmurs, gazing up at the stars.

page21.text:
...The flickering repeats.
Fever permeates my body, and I can't feel myself walking.

page22.text:
Someone said something about catching a fever.
It feels like mosquitoes carrying fever are spreading through my body and swarming around my fingertips.

page24.text:
In my daze, I can't distinguish dreams from reality.
It's like I'm already asleep and trying my damnedest to escape from the dream back to my bedroom.

page25.text:
"Sakura...? Weren't you asleep?"
"Please move out of the way. The way you're holding him, it'll just be more painful for him."

page26.text:
"No, this is my duty.
Besides, if he's contracted some disease, it could spread to you."
"...That's not what I mean.
Saber, I don't know what you've been doing with Senpai. I know you won't tell me, so I haven't bothered to ask."

page27.text:
"But every day since you arrived, Senpai has looked like he's suffering.
...If that was all, I would tolerate it. But he came back injured tonight!"
"Sakura, I—"

page28.text:
"I don't know what your circumstances are. But there has to be a better way than this!
If you can't even manage that, then don't involve him any further!"

page29.text:
...I'm brought back to my room.
Someone's next to me, putting me to bed, I think.

page31.text:
I think they whispered into my ear, but I couldn't make it out.
Did they say they were reckless?
Did they apologize to me?
